description.value: A heritage site and conservancy on Haida Gwaii covering 822 hectares near the community of Sandspit on North Moresby Island. The site protects old-growth cedar and hemlock forests with Haida cultural values, productive marine foreshore habitat, and overwintering grounds for Brant geese. The popular Louise Dover Trail is a 4 km moderate loop along a salmon river through ancient forest.
